# Burger Shop

> Burger Shop is a smash-burger restaurant serving beef patties smashed to order, with six burgers from $8.50 plus fries and drinks. This single-page site is the brand homepage: menu, order modes, and brand story.

## Sections

- [Home](https://burger-shop-xi.vercel.app/): the full homepage — hero, the six-burger menu with prices, the "make it a meal" offer, and the brand story.

## Menu

All burgers are made to order. Prices in US dollars.

- Classic Burger — $8.50
- Cheeseburger — $9.50
- Bacon Burger — $10.50
- Double Stack — $12.50
- Spicy Jalapeño — $11.50
- Veggie Burger — $9.50

Fries and drinks are available as an add-on to any burger.

## Frequently asked questions

- **How much do the burgers cost?** They range from $8.50 for the Classic Burger to $12.50 for the Double Stack.
- **How are the burgers cooked?** Beef patties are smashed to order and served on a toasted bun. Ingredients are simple and nothing is frozen.
- **Can I add fries and a drink?** Yes — any burger can be turned into a meal with fries and a drink.
- **How can I order?** Dine in, pickup, or delivery.

## Contact

Contact details, locations and opening hours are not published on this site yet.
